articles.title: Ukraine war briefing: Kyiv targets Russian-occupied Crimea as UK and France conduct joint military exercise
articles.summary:
Crimea strikes cause water and power cuts; war game designed to show how Nato countries could be defended amid fears of Russian aggression. What we know on day 1,705

A Ukrainian attack led to water and power cuts in occupied Crimea on Saturday, as a barrage of drones in several regions inside Russia left several dead, according to Russian authorities. Sergei Aksyonov, the Moscow-installed head of the Crimean peninsula, wrote on Telegram that due to the drone attack on local power grids “restrictions on the supply of electricity and water have been put in place”. He did not specify how many households had been affected in Crimea, which is home to more than 2.5 million people. The peninsula, which was seized from Ukraine by Russia in 2014, is a regular target for Ukrainian attacks.

A separate Ukrainian strike in part of the north-eastern Kharkiv region held by Russia killed at least three people and gravely wounded another on Saturday, the Moscow-backed authorities said.

Drones also rained down inside Russia. The country’s defence ministry said 616 of them had been shot down overnight across more than 20 regions of the country. During the day, drones hit Russia’s south-western Bryansk border region, killing at least three people, regional acting governor Yegor Kovalchuc said on Telegram.

In Ukraine, authorities said that at least five people died in several Russian drone and missile strikes in the country’s east. Dnipropetrovsk regional governor Oleksandr Ganzha on Saturday evening said three people were killed and at least 12 wounded when a Russian drone strike hit the town of Synelnykove, setting the fourth floor of a high-rise building on fire. Authorities in Sumy meanwhile said a Russian drone hit a farm, killing a 31-year-old woman and injuring four others.

Thousands of British and French troops have taken part in a military training exercise that included one of Britain’s largest airborne operations in two decades, the UK government said on Sunday. The war game is designed to show how Nato countries could be defended against a modern-day attack and comes during fears about Russian aggression in Europe amid Moscow’s war against Ukraine.

About 2,500 troops were involved in the seven-week exercise, in which 600 British and French paratroopers dropped from four RAF A400M Atlas transport aircraft over Germany. The exercise called Rhino Titan, held at the Sennelager military training centre in Germany, has been testing British troops’ ability against an enemy equipped with drones and electronic warfare. “The threats we face in the 21st century require an updated, modern approach to warfare – and our adaptable armed forces are preparing accordingly,” British defence minister Wes Streeting said in a statement.

Ukraine’s military has a “stable connection to Starlink”, the Ukrainian government said, 10 days after its ability to use the satellite communications system was suddenly restricted. But hours after the announcement, SpaceX CEO Elon Musk, whose company owns Starlink, accused the Ukrainian military of violating ⁠the company’s terms. Neither Musk nor the US government, which operates Starshield using Starlink technology, took responsibility for imposing the curbs.

Bulgarians will vote ​in presidential elections on Sunday as Russia’s war in Ukraine spreads to the waters off Bulgaria’s Black Sea coast. Polls place acting president Iliana ⁠Iotova and ex-caretaker prime minister Andrey Gyurov as leaders in a race of 27 candidates. While the presidency is largely ceremonial, Sunday’s vote has taken ⁠on added significance after a series of drone attacks on merchant ships off Bulgaria’s Black Sea ​coast that likely killed about two-dozen international ‌seafarers.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí eskalujícímu vnitřnímu napětí kvůli rozsáhlým protivládním protestům a zákazům shromažďování ve Francii, zatímco energetické trhy reagují na hrozby blízkovýchodního konfliktu růstem cen ropy a tankerových sazeb. Válka na Ukrajině pokračuje v kritické fázi s útoky na logistiku a spory ohledně satelitní komunikace, což udržuje vysokou geopolitickou prémii.
archive.security_status_en: Europe faces escalating internal tension due to widespread anti-government protests and assembly bans in France, while energy markets react to Middle Eastern conflict risks with surging oil prices and tanker rates. The war in Ukraine continues in a critical phase with strikes on logistics and disputes over satellite communications, maintaining a high geopolitical risk premium.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat přetrvávající napětí na francouzských finančních trzích v důsledku protestů a pokračující volatilitu cen energetických komodit.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, persistent tension in French financial markets due to protests and ongoing volatility in energy commodity prices are expected.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí kombinaci eskalujících sociálních nepokojů a politické nestability, přičemž Francie se potýká s rozsáhlými protesty, zaváděním zákazů vycházení a nadcházejícím hodnocením dluhového ratingu agenturou Moody’s. Východní Evropa a Balkán zažívají napjaté volební a protivládní protestní akce (Sbsko, Albánie), zatímco logistická podpora pro Ukrajinu naráží na přetrvávající technická omezení satelitního systému Starlink.
archive.security_status_en: Europe is facing a combination of escalating social unrest and political instability, with France grappling with widespread protests, curfews, and an impending Moody’s debt rating review. Eastern Europe and the Balkans are experiencing tense electoral and anti-government protests (Serbia, Albania), while logistical support for Ukraine encounters persistent technical restrictions on the Starlink satellite system.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat volatilitu na francouzských trzích po rozhodnutí ratingové agentury Moody’s a pokračující napětí kolem protivládních demonstrací. Zvýšená pozornost se soustředí i na volební víkend v Srbsku.
archive.forecast_en: Volatility in French markets is expected in the coming days following Moody’s rating decision, alongside ongoing tensions surrounding anti-government demonstrations. Heightened attention will also focus on the election weekend in Serbia.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí kombinaci vnitřního napětí, včetně rasistických útoků ve Francii a politických nepokojů, a přetrvávajících geopolitických rizik na svých hranicích. Balkánské volby a válečný konflikt na Ukrajině, kde se objevují nové útoky na ruskou digitální infrastrukturu a eskalace v Černém moři, udržují vysokou pohotovost bezpečnostních složek.
archive.security_status_en: Europe is facing a combination of internal tensions, including racist attacks in France and political unrest, alongside lingering geopolitical risks at its borders. Balkan elections and the war in Ukraine, marked by new strikes on Russian digital infrastructure and Black Sea escalation, keep security forces on high alert.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech se očekává zvýšená volatilita na evropských trzích vlivem vývoje francouzské politické scény, napětí na Blízkém východě a vyhodnocování volebních výsledků na Balkáně.
archive.forecast_en: Increased volatility is expected in European markets over the coming days driven by French political developments, Middle Eastern tensions, and the evaluation of Balkan election results.

archive.security_status_cs: Francie čelí masivním protestům a přísným bezpečnostním opatřením po teroristickém útoku a předchozích nepokojích, což zvyšuje politickou nestabilitu v zemi. Ukrajinské útoky na ruská datová centra a pokračující válka mezitím udržují vysoké geopolitické napětí napříč kontinentem.
archive.security_status_en: France is facing massive protests and strict security deployments following a terrorist attack and previous riots, exacerbating political instability in the country. Meanwhile, Ukrainian strikes on Russian data centers and the ongoing war keep geopolitical tensions high across the continent.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech se očekává zvýšená nervozita na trzích v reakci na bezpečnostní situaci ve Francii a vývoj kolem ukrajinských útoků v Rusku. Investoři budou nadále sledovat makroekonomická data a politická rizika v regionu.
archive.forecast_en: Increased market nervousness is expected in the coming days in response to the security situation in France and developments surrounding Ukrainian strikes in Russia. Investors will continue monitoring macroeconomic data and regional political risks.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí vážným vnitřním i vnějším tlakům, v čele s rozsáhlými protivládními protesty a sociálními nepokoji ve Francii a Itálii a přetrvávající bezpečnostní hrozbou spojenou s válkou na Ukrajině. Zatímco Ukrajina stabilizovala své klíčové komunikační linky Starlink a pokračuje v úderech na okupovaný Krym, stupňující se napětí v regionu a eskalující sociální nepokoje vytvářejí silný tlak na evropské trhy a politickou stabilitu.
archive.security_status_en: Europe is facing severe internal and external pressures, led by massive anti-government protests and social unrest in France and Italy alongside the enduring security threat of the war in Ukraine. While Ukraine has stabilized its critical Starlink communication lines and continues strikes on occupied Crimea, mounting regional tensions and escalating social unrest exert heavy pressure on European markets and political stability.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat přetrvávající volatilitu na trzích vlivem neustávajících protestů v západní Evropě a bezpečnostních obav spojených s vývojem na Ukrajině.
archive.forecast_en: Persistent market volatility is expected over the coming days driven by ongoing protests in Western Europe and security concerns linked to developments in Ukraine.
